scope: Direct inspection of 14 final native screenshots, including all 32 authored poses in three matrices. Basic character appearance and action acceptance only.
observations: Silver armor, white cape/plume and long beard remain consistent with current commander portrait.
Four distinct directions, alternating gait A/B and windup/strike poses are visible in the matrices; no clipping or floating feet found.
Spear grips retain left hand forward and right hand rear in standing poses; collapse and terminal frames retain character identity.

Normal combat screenshots show damage, selected character/HUD, movement, hurt and death. NE normal screenshots are partly occluded by the existing flag; unobstructed matrix confirms the underlying poses.
The physics probe records the first real HP decrease at strike; later screenshots can show recovery.
Current portrait is readable at all four sampled sizes and in the actual Codex/HUD.
limitations: Not complete Daming campaign rescue, balance, long-run performance, device or platform package acceptance.
